districts.name: Chautauqua Grove
districts.style: tiny Victorian board-and-batten cottages and Queen Anne houses with gingerbread trim, picket fences

districts.name: The Cooperage
districts.style: old red-brick cannery warehouses converted into lofts, corrugated metal sheds, loading docks

districts.name: Old Wharf
districts.style: two-story Victorian Italianate storefronts with wooden cornices, old harbor buildings, weathered clapboard

districts.name: Mission Plaza
districts.style: Spanish Colonial Revival buildings with white stucco walls, red clay tile roofs and arched arcades

districts.name: Pine Heights
districts.style: Craftsman bungalows with deep porches and shingle siding on winding hillside streets among Monterey pines

districts.name: Seaview Terrace
districts.style: mid-century modern single-story ranch houses with low-pitched roofs, carports and wide lawns

districts.name: Millworks
districts.style: light industrial area with metal warehouses, chain-link fences, a former lumber mill and auto shops

proposals.text: Someone dumped a broken recliner next to the bus stop last night.
Graffiti on the side of the old cannery wall facing the bike path.
Storm drain fully blocked with leaves, the street floods every time it rains.
Pile of tires behind the auto shop fence, been there two weeks.
Overflowing can at the corner, trash blowing into the street.
Fallen eucalyptus branch blocking half of the sidewalk.
Old mattress leaning on the fence by the playground.
Shopping carts abandoned in the creek access path.
